snippet.title: Jupiter & Mars Definitive Edition Launch Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Tigertron's groundbreaking oceanic adventure game -- a dolphivania -- comes to Nintendo Switch for the first time bearing a wealth of new additions and improvements: A new default 3rd-person perspective, graphical improvements, QoL upgrades, and a new ending theme song 'Blue Life' by Japanese electronic music legend, Ken Ishii. 

Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition launches for Nintendo Switch on September 10, 2026! The game even features Ecco the Dolphin creator, Ed Annunziata, in a special guest appearance. It's up to eagle-eyed players to find track him down. 

Background: Jupiter & Mars made its debut at Stockholm's Fotgrafiska gallery, in front of esteemed guests like Sweden's prime minister and SeaLegacy's Paul Nicklen. 

Jupiter & Mars was later featured in a year-long exhibit at the ACMI, Melbourne's national museum, in 2022. https://www.acmi.net.au/works/117924--jupiter-and-mars/

As a pioneering, environmentally-theme adventure game (originally developed for PlayStation 4 Pro), Jupiter & Mars now arrives on Nintendo Switch in its Definitive Edition, making it accessible to an even bigger global audience, at home in docked mode, or on the go in portable form. Solve the mysteries of the oceans with Jupiter and Mars today!
